cards.english_title: Iran Executes Three Men After January Unrest
cards.korean_desc: 이란은 2026년 11월 8일 세 남자를 처형했다. 사법부는 1월 시위 중 카라지 공격을 혐의로 제기했다. 당국은 총기와 수류탄이 공공시설을 훼손했다고 말했다. 대법원은 형을 확정했고 다른 10명은 5~10년형을 받았다.
cards.english_desc: Iran executed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh on November 8, 2026. The judiciary accused them of attacks in Karaj during January protests. Officials said firearms, grenades and Molotov cocktails damaged public facilities. The Supreme Court upheld the sentences; ten others received five-to-ten-year terms.
cards.hook: Iran executed three men after January unrest.
cards.takeaway_english: The executions deepen debate over security, evidence and protest rights in Iran.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이번 처형은 이란의 안보와 시위 권리 논쟁을 키운다.

why_it_matters.english: Executions affect families and intensify concern about protest rights.
why_it_matters.korean: 처형은 가족에게 영향을 주고 시위 권리 우려를 키운다.

why_it_matters.english: The case shows how unrest is being treated through criminal courts.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 사건은 법원이 불안을 다루는 방식을 보여준다.

parties.label: Iranian judiciary
parties.english: It accused the men of armed attacks and violence.

parties.label: Three men
parties.english: They were sentenced to death after convictions.
parties.korean: 세 남자는 유죄 판결 뒤 사형을 선고받았다.

parties.label: Other defendants
parties.english: Ten others received prison terms of five to ten years.

views.label: Iranian authorities
views.english: Officials say the executions punished armed attacks during unrest and protected public security.
views.korean: 당국은 처형이 무장 공격을 처벌했다고 말한다.

views.label: Rights groups
views.english: Rights groups say Iran has used forced confessions against protesters, but Iran disputes those accusations.
views.korean: 인권단체는 강제 자백을 말하지만 이란은 부인한다.

disagree.english: The available evidence does not independently confirm how the convictions were obtained.
disagree.korean: 공개된 증거만으로는 유죄 과정이 확인되지 않는다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 폭력이 관련된 시위 사건을 법원은 어떻게 다뤄야 할까요?

caption_lines: The executions followed Supreme Court approval.
cards.reader_question: How should courts handle protest cases involving violence?

sentences.english: Officials said firearms, grenades and Molotov cocktails damaged public facilities.
sentences.korean: 당국은 총기와 수류탄이 공공시설을 훼손했다고 말했다.

cards.english_title: Trump Offers UFC Chief the Press Secretary Job
cards.korean_desc: 민주당은 중간선거에서 의회 양원을 이겼다. 화이트는 워싱턴으로 가 11월 9일 트럼프를 만난다고 말했다. 화이트는 수락하지 않았고 트럼프는 민주당 조사를 지시했다.
cards.english_desc: The offer came after Democrats won both chambers in the midterm elections. White said he was flying to Washington and would meet Trump on November 9. White had not formally accepted, while Trump also requested investigations of Democrats.
cards.hook: Trump offered Dana White the press secretary job.
cards.takeaway_english: The offer links Trump’s political brand with UFC loyalty as Congress turns against him.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이번 제안은 의회가 등을 돌린 가운데 트럼프와 UFC의 연결을 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: The press secretary speaks for the president and faces daily media questions.
why_it_matters.korean: 대변인은 대통령을 대신해 매일 언론 질문을 받는다.

why_it_matters.english: Democratic control of Congress could bring investigations of the administration.
why_it_matters.korean: 민주당의 의회 장악은 행정부 조사를 불러올 수 있다.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: He offered the vacant press secretary job to Dana White.
parties.korean: 그는 빈 대변인직을 데이나 화이트에게 제안했다.

parties.label: Dana White
parties.english: He said he was flying to Washington for a November 9 meeting.
parties.korean: 그는 11월 9일 회의를 위해 워싱턴으로 간다고 말했다.

parties.label: Democrats
parties.english: They will control both chambers of Congress in January.

views.label: Trump supporters
views.english: They may see White as a loyal outsider who can challenge hostile media and Democrats.
views.korean: 지지자들은 화이트를 언론과 민주당에 맞설 충성스러운 외부인으로 볼 수 있다.

views.label: Critics
views.english: Critics may see the offer as a political stunt during a difficult transition.
views.korean: 비판자들은 이 제안을 어려운 전환기의 정치적 묘수로 볼 수 있다.

disagree.english: White had not formally accepted, and reports differed about whether the offer was serious.
disagree.korean: 화이트는 공식 수락을 하지 않았고 제안의 진정성 보도도 엇갈렸다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 스포츠 경영자는 좋은 정치 대변인이 될까요?

cards.english_title: Central Japan Earthquake Injures At Least 22
cards.korean_desc: 규모 5.5~5.7 지진이 2026년 11월 8일 일본 중부를 강타했다. 진앙은 시즈오카현 지하 약 40킬로미터에 있었다. 당국은 며칠간 강진과 산사태와 낙석을 경고했다.
cards.english_desc: A magnitude 5.5-to-5.7 earthquake struck central Japan early on November 8, 2026. The epicenter lay about 40 kilometers beneath Shizuoka Prefecture. Officials warned of strong quakes, mudslides and falling rocks over the next several days.
cards.hook: A central Japan quake injured at least 22 people.
cards.takeaway_english: Japan is watching the next several days while transport moves cautiously.
cards.takeaway_korean: 일본은 교통을 조심스럽게 운영하며 며칠을 지켜본다.

why_it_matters.english: Earthquakes can disrupt transport and injure people during evacuation.
why_it_matters.korean: 지진은 대피 중 교통을 막고 사람을 다치게 할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Warnings give residents time to prepare water, food and batteries.
why_it_matters.korean: 경고는 주민에게 물과 음식과 배터리를 준비할 시간을 준다.

parties.label: Japan Meteorological Agency
parties.english: It measured the earthquake at magnitude 5.7 and warned about more strong shaking.
parties.korean: 기상청은 규모 5.7로 측정하고 강한 흔들림을 경고했다.

parties.label: U.S. Geological Survey
parties.english: It measured the earthquake at magnitude 5.5.

parties.label: Residents
parties.english: People fled buildings, and some fell on stairs.
parties.korean: 사람들은 건물에서 달아났고 일부는 계단에서 넘어졌다.

views.label: Japanese officials
views.english: Officials urge preparation for aftershocks, mudslides and falling rocks.
views.korean: 일본 당국은 여진과 산사태를 대비하라고 촉구한다.

views.label: Seismic authorities
views.english: Officials detected no apparent change so far at the Nankai Trough plate.
views.korean: 당국은 난카이 해곡에 뚜렷한 변화를 보지 못했다.

disagree.english: The magnitude differed between agencies, showing that early earthquake measurements can change.
disagree.korean: 기관마다 규모가 달라 초기 측정은 바뀔 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 다음 지진 전에 지역사회는 무엇을 준비해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Eisenkot Gets First Chance to Form Israel’s Government
cards.korean_desc: 10월 27일 선거는 누구에게도 과반을 주지 않았다. 아이젠코트 연합은 48석, 네타냐후 연합은 53석을 얻었다. 아이젠코트는 연정을 만들 28일과 추가 14일을 얻는다.
cards.english_desc: The October 27 election left neither Eisenkot nor Netanyahu with a majority. Eisenkot’s bloc won 48 seats, while Netanyahu’s bloc won 53 of 120. Eisenkot has 28 days to build a coalition, plus a possible 14-day extension.
cards.hook: Eisenkot got the first chance after Israel’s deadlocked election.
cards.korean_hook: 교착 선거 뒤 아이젠코트가 첫 기회를 얻었다.
cards.takeaway_english: Eisenkot has the first move, but the numbers still make a government difficult.
cards.takeaway_korean: 아이젠코트가 먼저 움직이지만 의석 계산은 여전히 어렵다.

why_it_matters.english: The coalition talks will decide who leads Israel after a tied election.
why_it_matters.korean: 연정 협상은 교착 선거 뒤 이스라엘의 지도자를 결정한다.

why_it_matters.english: Another failed attempt could send voters back to the polls.
why_it_matters.korean: 또 실패하면 유권자들은 다시 투표할 수 있다.

parties.label: Gadi Eisenkot
parties.english: He has 28 days, with a possible 14-day extension, to form a coalition.
parties.korean: 그는 연정을 만들 28일과 추가 14일을 가질 수 있다.

parties.label: Benjamin Netanyahu
parties.english: His bloc won 53 seats, below the 61-seat majority.

parties.label: Arab parties
parties.english: Their 19 seats could help Eisenkot, though he has resisted joining them.
parties.korean: 아랍 정당의 19석은 도움 되지만 그는 연대를 꺼렸다.

views.label: Eisenkot’s supporters
views.english: They see him as a possible centrist alternative to Netanyahu’s religious-nationalist bloc.
views.korean: 지지자들은 그를 네타냐후 연합의 중도 대안으로 본다.

views.label: Coalition skeptics
views.english: Analysts say all main coalition paths look unlikely after the deadlocked vote.
views.korean: 분석가들은 교착 선거 뒤 모든 연정 선택이 어렵다고 말한다.

disagree.english: His opponents may argue that a government relying on outside Arab support would be unstable.
disagree.korean: 반대자들은 아랍의 외부 지원에 의존한 정부가 불안정하다고 말할 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 정치 목표가 다른 정당들도 연정에 참여해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Two Tankers Burn After Reported Mine Strikes
cards.korean_desc: 이란 혁명수비대는 선박들이 허가 없는 길에서 기뢰를 맞았다고 말했다. 수비대는 통과 중 항법 장치가 꺼졌다고 말했다. 미국은 최근 해협의 기뢰를 제거했다고 말했다.
cards.english_desc: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said the ships used unauthorized routes and struck naval mines. The Guards said navigation systems were switched off during the crossing. The United States said it had recently cleared mines from the waterway.
cards.hook: Iran says two tankers caught fire after hitting mines.
cards.korean_hook: 이란은 유조선 2척이 기뢰에 맞아 불탔다고 말했다.
cards.takeaway_english: The competing accounts leave shipping safety and responsibility unresolved.
cards.takeaway_korean: 엇갈린 주장은 선박 안전과 책임을 여전히 해결하지 못했다.

why_it_matters.english: Hormuz normally carries about one-fifth of global oil consumption.
why_it_matters.korean: 호르무즈 해협은 보통 세계 석유 소비의 약 5분의 1을 운반한다.

why_it_matters.english: Shipping danger can affect fuel prices and deliveries far beyond the region.
why_it_matters.korean: 선박 위험은 지역 밖 연료 가격과 배송에도 영향을 줄 수 있다.

parties.label: Iranian Revolutionary Guards
parties.english: They said the tankers used unauthorized routes and struck naval mines.
parties.korean: 혁명수비대는 유조선들이 허가받지 않은 길에서 기뢰를 맞았다고 말했다.

parties.label: United States
parties.english: It says its forces have helped tankers and cleared mines from the waterway.
parties.korean: 미국은 선박을 돕고 해협의 기뢰를 제거했다고 말한다.

parties.label: Shipping companies
parties.english: They face greater danger in a waterway carrying major oil traffic.
parties.korean: 해운사들은 주요 석유 수송로에서 더 큰 위험을 맞는다.

views.label: Iranian authorities
views.english: Iran says the tankers violated navigation rules and crossed unauthorized routes.
views.korean: 이란은 유조선들이 항해 규정을 어겼다고 말한다.

views.label: U.S. officials
views.english: The United States says mines have been cleared, challenging Iran’s account of continuing mine danger.
views.korean: 미국은 기뢰를 제거했다고 말해 이란 주장에 이의를 제기한다.

disagree.english: The tanker names, nationalities and independent confirmation of the mine strikes were not provided.
disagree.korean: 유조선 이름과 국적, 기뢰 충돌의 독립 확인은 공개되지 않았다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 전쟁 중인 해협의 안전 통행을 누가 보장해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Three More Dead Found at Krakow Suspect’s Home
cards.korean_desc: 앞서 용의자는 크라쿠프 광장에서 6명을 죽이고 15명을 다치게 했다. 경찰은 군복과 방탄조끼를 입은 공격자를 쏴 다치게 했다. 당국은 총격범이 혼자 행동했고 수사가 계속된다고 말했다.
cards.english_desc: Earlier, the suspect killed six people and injured fifteen in Krakow’s Main Square. Police shot and wounded the attacker, who was wearing military-style clothing and a vest. Authorities said the gunman acted alone, while the investigation continued.
cards.hook: Three people were found dead in the suspect’s home.
cards.takeaway_english: Investigators must now establish what happened both in the square and inside the home.
cards.takeaway_korean: 수사관들은 광장과 집에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 밝혀야 한다.

why_it_matters.english: The attack affected a major tourist area in Poland’s second-largest city.
why_it_matters.korean: 공격은 폴란드 제2도시의 주요 관광지를 덮쳤다.

why_it_matters.english: The deaths at the home widened the investigation beyond the public shooting.
why_it_matters.korean: 집 안 사망은 수사를 공공장소 총격 너머로 넓혔다.

parties.label: Krakow authorities
parties.english: They said the gunman killed six people and injured fifteen in the square.
parties.korean: 당국은 총격범이 광장에서 6명을 죽이고 15명을 다치게 했다고 말했다.

parties.label: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk
parties.english: He said the three people found at home were likely close family members.
parties.korean: 투스크 총리는 집의 3명이 가까운 가족 같다고 말했다.

parties.label: Krakow residents
parties.english: The city entered official mourning until Wednesday.

views.label: Polish authorities
views.english: Officials described the shooting as terrorism and said the attacker acted alone.
views.korean: 당국은 총격을 테러로 규정하고 단독 범행이라고 말했다.

views.label: Investigators
views.english: Investigators were still identifying two victims and determining details about the home deaths.
views.korean: 수사관들은 피해자 2명과 집 안 사망을 확인 중이었다.

disagree.english: The authorities had not publicly explained the motive or confirmed the family relationship.
disagree.korean: 당국은 동기와 가족 관계를 아직 공식 확인하지 않았다.

cards.short_korean: 앞서 용의자는 크라쿠프 광장에서 6명을 죽이고 15명을 다치게 했다.
